end.parentNote: Asha practised water changes using drying clothes, steam, wet glasses, glaciers, and seawater. Sana first said dried water was gone, then corrected this by saying it moves into the air as vapour; the mix-up was corrected later in the lesson (correctAfterLastSeen). They also identified seawater as salty and glacier water as fresh. At home, ask Sana to explain one example each of evaporation, condensation, freezing, and melting.
